keys.name: colorspace
keys.text: The name of the colorspace of the pixels, as defined in the OCIO config.

keys.name: OCIO config
keys.text: The config that defines the colorspace: an absolute path plus a template with root tokens that another machine can resolve.

keys.name: display and view
keys.text: Present when the images are display-referred, set by the host or by a transcode to a display and view.

keys.name: file rules
keys.text: Project rules that assign a colorspace from the file name when the host cannot tell.

keys.name: transcode profile
keys.text: Settings that select the instances to convert and define the output colorspace or display and view.

steps.title: Scene colorspace
steps.subtitle: Host integration
steps.now: The integration reads the colorspace and the OCIO config of the rendered or exported images from the scene (render settings, write nodes, render products).
steps.expected: The colorspace and config are stored on the instance.

steps.title: colorspaceData set
steps.subtitle: Extract stage
steps.now: Each image representation gets a colorspaceData entry from the instance, with the colorspace name and the OCIO config.
steps.expected: The files and their colorspace are described together.

steps.title: OIIO transcode
steps.subtitle: When a profile matches
steps.now: If a transcode profile matches the instance, the images are converted with OpenImageIO to a target colorspace or to a display and view, and a new representation is created for each output definition.
steps.expected: New representations whose colorspaceData describes the target. Without a matching profile, nothing changes.

steps.title: Review media
steps.subtitle: Encoded with FFmpeg
steps.now: Representations that carry the review tag are encoded into review media. The encoding does not apply an OCIO transform itself: the transform comes from the transcode step or from the host.
steps.expected: A movie or image that inherits the colorspaceData of its input.

steps.title: Thumbnail
steps.subtitle: One image per version
steps.now: One image is converted to a JPEG thumbnail with OpenImageIO when its representation has colorspaceData, and with FFmpeg otherwise.

steps.title: Stored
steps.subtitle: Integrate stage
steps.now: The colorspaceData of each representation is stored in its data on the AYON server, and the colorspace name is available as the {colorspace} key of the publish templates.
steps.expected: Loaders and later steps can read the colorspace of every published file.

steps.title: Files chosen
steps.subtitle: Tray Publisher or farm job
steps.now: The files come without color information from a host, for example plates added in the Tray Publisher.
steps.expected: The files have no colorspaceData yet.

steps.title: File rules
steps.subtitle: Colorspace by file name
steps.now: A rule of the project color settings assigns a colorspace from the file name and extension. The colorspace is not checked against the config at this point.
steps.expected: The representation gets colorspaceData with the colorspace and the OCIO config of the context.

steps.title: OIIO transcode
steps.subtitle: When a profile matches
steps.now: A matching transcode profile converts the images exactly as for images from the scene.
steps.expected: New representations with the target colorspace or display and view.

steps.title: Review media and thumbnail
steps.subtitle: As above
steps.now: Review media and the thumbnail are made from the representations as described for images from the scene.

steps.title: Stored
steps.subtitle: Integrate stage
steps.now: The colorspaceData is stored with each published representation.
steps.expected: The colorspace of every published file is on record.
